D: Earth's mightiest heroes team up to stop Loki's invasion of New York.
P: Serve the shawarma during the end credits, when the team eats in silence.
S: Stark Tower seared tuna and wasabi bites
drinks at the top of the tower, before Loki arrives

Sesame-crusted tuna seared rare on crisp cucumber with wasabi mayo and pickled ginger, beside mini Yorkshires stuffed with rare beef and horseradish. Roll 300g sashimi tuna in sesame seeds and sear 30 seconds a side, then slice. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp wasabi. Top 16 thick cucumber rounds with mayo, tuna and pickled ginger. Whisk 2 eggs, 100g flour and 125ml milk, pour into a hot oiled mini muffin tin and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Fill with sliced rare roast beef and horseradish cream.
after the battle, round the corner from the shawarma place

Silky tahini hummus topped with sizzling cumin-spiced lamb mince, pine nuts and chilli oil, with warm flatbread for scooping. Blitz 2 drained 400g tins chickpeas with 100g tahini, 1 garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon, salt and 80ml ice water for 3 minutes until very smooth. Fry 250g lamb mince in oil until crisp, adding 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp paprika. Toast 30g pine nuts. Swirl the hummus onto a plate, spoon the hot lamb over, add pine nuts, chilli oil and parsley. Warm 4 flatbreads.
Mixed nuts tossed in honey, butter, thyme and sea salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes.
M: Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon and lemon, grilled and sliced. Warm flatbread, toum (garlic, oil, lemon emulsified), pickles, tomato and parsley.
W: Sugar cookie rounds iced in concentric red and white rings with a blue centre and white star.
K: Ginger beer stirred with honey and lemon over ice, or real mead for the grown-ups.

Fry 250g lamb mince in oil until crisp, adding 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp paprika. Toast 30g pine nuts. Toss 400g mixed nuts with 2 tbsp honey, 30g melted butter and chopped thyme. Roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once. Sprinkle with flaky salt while warm and stir as they cool so they don't stick together.

m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 150g yoghurt, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp each cumin, coriander and paprika, a pinch of cinnamon and lemon juice overnight. Grill and slice. Serve in 4 warm flatbreads with garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut 12 rounds and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Mix 300g icing sugar with water to a thick icing, tint some red and some blue, and ice rings with a blue centre and white star.

d.how: Stir 1 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon into each of four glasses until dissolved. Fill with ice and top with ginger beer. For the grown-ups, pour 120ml chilled mead instead. Raise the glasses high.
